subject: [PATCH 5/7] NFSD: report listener creation failures through extack

2026-08-10.patch_summary: This patch improves error reporting for NFS listener creation failures by providing a detailed message through the extack mechanism, including the transport and error code. This allows userland to better diagnose issues such as an unreachable local rpcbind. The patch only affects the handling of LISTENER_SET errors and leaves other rejection cases unchanged.
